The '''XR12''' was a type of personal-use [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] that was produced by [[Bendine/Legends|Bendine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was capsule-shaped and smaller than an average [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].

One such craft was the ''[[Satellite Liberator]]'', which wound up in [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junkyard]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].
